violent.label: Violent / Tense
modifiers: violent action between one group against another
a tense standoff, weapons half-drawn
chaos breaking out, shouts and scrambling

charming.label: Charming / Idyllic
modifiers: casual, peaceful socialization between subjects
warm camaraderie, easy laughter
a relaxed, unhurried moment

satirical.label: Satirical / Comedic
modifiers: exaggerated, playful antics
a moment of absurd showmanship
an air of comic exaggeration

eerie.label: Eerie / Uncanny
modifiers: an unsettling stillness hanging over the scene
something quietly wrong just beneath the surface
a hushed, watchful tension

mundane.label: Mundane / Domestic
modifiers: figures absorbed in ordinary business, unaware of the frame
an unremarkable slice of daily routine
neither spectacle nor crisis, just the everyday

triumphant.label: Triumphant / Victorious
modifiers: a surge of hard-won triumph, chins lifted
hands raised, victory taking hold
clean, exultant relief after a struggle won

melancholy.label: Melancholy / Wistful
modifiers: a quiet ache beneath the stillness
figures lingering as if reluctant to leave
a soft, unhurried sorrow

solemn.label: Solemn / Ceremonial
modifiers: a hushed formality settling over the scene
measured, deliberate movement, heads bowed
gravity in every gesture, nothing rushed

romantic.label: Romantic / Tender
modifiers: an intimacy in the space between two figures
unhurried closeness, attention paid only to each other
warmth held in a lingering glance

restless.label: Restless / Anxious
modifiers: a nervous energy that won't settle
fidgeting hands, eyes darting toward the door
tension without release, waiting for something to break
